parameters.name: SubscriptionName
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend sub = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| where isnotempty(sub)
| summarize by sub
| sort by sub asc
| project value = sub

content.json:
# Azure AI Platform — Health Dashboard

Platform-wide operational view of token consumption, request throughput, and latency percentiles across all layers. Use this workbook alongside the **Backend Routing Report** (circuit-breaker / failover) and the **End-to-End Trace** (per-request waterfall drill-down).

| Section | What it answers |
|---|---|
| **Token Usage** | How many tokens per minute is the platform consuming? Which LOB is spending the most? Am I approaching Foundry's shared 1K TPM primary cap? |
| **Request Rate** | How many requests/minute is the platform handling in total, and how is that load split across LOBs? |
| **Latency Percentiles per Layer** | Where is the latency sitting — App Gateway WAF, APIM policy overhead, or Foundry inference? What is the P50/P95/P99 spread for each layer? |

**Foundry primary shared cap: 1 000 TPM** (East US).  When the platform-wide TPM line approaches 1 000, expect circuit-breaker trips and failover to secondary (West US, 30K TPM). Correlate with the Backend Routing Report.

## Token Usage

Tokens per minute extracted from `Response-X-Tokens-Used` captured in `AppRequests` via APIM diagnostics. Requires the `azure-openai-emit-token-metric` policy (active after `azd provision`).

**Product tier TPM caps:** Bronze 500 · Silver 5 000 · Gold 5 500. **Foundry primary pool: 1 000 TPM total** (shared across all subscriptions). When stacked bars reach ~1 000 combined, expect primary Foundry 429s and circuit-breaker failover to secondary.

content.query:
let sub_filter  = "{SubscriptionName}";
let bucket_secs = totimespan("{Granularity}") / 1s;
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend sub      = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| extend totalTok = toint(Properties["Response-X-Tokens-Used"])
| where isnotempty(sub) and totalTok > 0
| where sub_filter == "value:all" or sub == sub_filter
| summarize BucketTokens = sum(totalTok) by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), sub
| extend TPM = round(toreal(BucketTokens) / max_of(toreal(bucket_secs) / 60.0, 1.0), 1)
| project TimeGenerated, Subscription = sub, TPM
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: TPM over time — stacked by LOB subscription (tokens/min normalised to bucket width)

content.json:
## Request Rate

Requests per minute sourced from `AppRequests` (same source as the TPM panel) so the Subscription filter works consistently across all panels.

- **Platform RPM** — total requests/min, filtered by the Subscription selector above
- **RPM by LOB** — stacked area showing which subscriptions are generating load

A single LOB dominating (tall solid band) = that application is near its product rate limit. Multiple LOBs growing simultaneously = combined load risk on Foundry primary pool.

content.query:
let sub_filter  = "{SubscriptionName}";
let bucket_secs = totimespan("{Granularity}") / 1s;
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend sub = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| where isnotempty(sub)
| where sub_filter == "value:all" or sub == sub_filter
| summarize BucketRequests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity})
| extend RPM = round(toreal(BucketRequests) / max_of(toreal(bucket_secs) / 60.0, 1.0), 1)
| project TimeGenerated, ['Requests/min'] = RPM
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Platform RPM — total requests/min (use Subscription filter above to isolate a LOB)

content.json:
## Latency Percentiles per Layer

Nine time-series lines: **P50 · P95 · P99** for each of the three platform layers. Sources from `ApiManagementGatewayLogs` (low ingestion lag, ~30 s) joined to `AGWAccessLogs` on time bucket.

| Layer | Colour | Source field | Healthy P99 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **App Gateway** | 🔵 Blue | `AGWAccessLogs.TimeTaken × 1000` | < 200 ms (WAF + TLS) |
| **APIM overhead** | 🟠 Orange | `TotalTime − BackendTime` | < 100 ms |
| **Foundry inference** | 🟢 Green | `BackendTime` | < 3 000 ms (gpt-4o-mini) · < 8 000 ms (o1) |

**What a wide P50→P99 spread means:**
- Foundry: bimodal request mix (cache hits vs cold inference) or failover latency (+300–500 ms for West US secondary)
- APIM: occasional synchronous policy stall (semantic cache miss storm, Key Vault lookup)
- App GW: WAF rule triggering on some requests or TLS renegotiation

content.query:
let apim = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend apimOverheadMs = max_of(toreal(TotalTime) - toreal(BackendTime), 0.0)
| summarize
    ['Foundry P50 (ms)']       = round(percentile(toreal(BackendTime), 50), 1),
    ['Foundry P95 (ms)']       = round(percentile(toreal(BackendTime), 95), 1),
    ['Foundry P99 (ms)']       = round(percentile(toreal(BackendTime), 99), 1),
    ['APIM overhead P50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs, 50), 1),
    ['APIM overhead P95 (ms)'] = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs, 95), 1),
    ['APIM overhead P99 (ms)'] = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs, 99), 1)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity});
let agw = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    ['App GW P50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(toreal(TimeTaken), 50) * 1000, 1),
    ['App GW P95 (ms)'] = round(percentile(toreal(TimeTaken), 95) * 1000, 1),
    ['App GW P99 (ms)'] = round(percentile(toreal(TimeTaken), 99) * 1000, 1)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity});
apim
| join kind=leftouter agw on TimeGenerated
| project-away TimeGenerated1
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ['App GW P50 (ms)'],
    ['App GW P95 (ms)'],
    ['App GW P99 (ms)'],
    ['APIM overhead P50 (ms)'],
    ['APIM overhead P95 (ms)'],
    ['APIM overhead P99 (ms)'],
    ['Foundry P50 (ms)'],
    ['Foundry P95 (ms)'],
    ['Foundry P99 (ms)']
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Latency percentiles per layer — P50 · P95 · P99 for App GW (blue), APIM overhead (orange), Foundry inference (green)
